name: Kirtar
description: An aven lieutenant who plots a coup against Captain Pianna and holds the Mirari before Turg takes it.

description_citations.text: "Turg". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Pianna assesses Lieutenant Kirtar's strengths and weaknesses.
timeline.quote: His strengths are pride, devotion, and ambition. His weaknesses are the same.

citation.text: Lieutenant Kirtar (Odyssey, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A Krosan dragon besieges Cabal City; Kamahl is crushed beneath its corpse and Kirtar seizes the glory and chooses the Mirari.
timeline.quote: Kirtar selected the Mirari, which granted him visions of dominion.

citation.text: "Battle for the Mirari", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Laquatus rewrites Kirtar's memory, sowing false alliances.
timeline.quote: Laquatus, ever the manipulator, had rewritten his memory

citation.text: "Battle for the Mirari", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kirtar flees to the Order's lands, pursued by Kamahl and Laquatus.
timeline.quote: Kirtar fled back to the Order lands, pursued by Kamahl and Laquatus

citation.text: "Battle for the Mirari", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Citadel, Kirtar, mad from the Mirari, encases Pianna in crystal and triggers a disaster that crystallizes half the Citadel at the cost of his life force.
timeline.quote: encased her in pure crystal and unwittingly triggered a disaster

citation.text: "Battle for the Mirari", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl, Seton and Laquatus leave after Kirtar, who has the sphere; Chainer resumes training under Skellum.
timeline.quote: Chainer resumes his training as a dementia summoner under his master Skellum

citation.text: "Chainer's Torment", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl kills a Krosan dragon attacking Cabal City but Lieutenant Kirtar is credited and takes the Mirari as his prize, starting the Battle for the Mirari.
timeline.quote: Kamahl thus began his journey to claim the artifact for himself.

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Kamahl's Odyssey". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kirtar uses the Mirari to crystallize much of the Order's fortress, including himself and Captain Pianna; Laquatus ends up with the Mirari.
timeline.quote: Kirtar used the device to cast a devastating spell that crystallized much of the fortress

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Kamahl's Odyssey". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kirtar competes in the Cabal's largest pit-fight tournament in Cabal City, hoping to win an artifact for the Order to destroy.
timeline.quote: Hoping to claim a powerful artifact for the Order to destroy

citation.text: "Kirtar", section "Pit fighter". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A Krosan dragon attacks the city, Kirtar leads the defense, and Kamahl kills the dragon, leaving Kirtar to receive the reward.
timeline.quote: Eventually, Kamahl killed the dragon

citation.text: "Kirtar", section "Pit fighter". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kirtar receives the Mirari and is overcome by the power it offers him.
timeline.quote: Kirtar was overcome by the power the device offered him

citation.text: "Kirtar", section "The Battle for the Mirari". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kirtar and his men repel beast attacks on the northern plains, then attack the forest of Krosa itself.
timeline.quote: Kirtar decides to take the initiative and attack the forest itself to slaughter any dangerous animals.

citation.text: "Kirtar", section "The Battle for the Mirari". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Laquatus, who had implanted false memories of friendship, joins Kirtar, and Pianna orders Kirtar and his men to withdraw.
timeline.quote: She ordered Kirtar and his men to withdraw back to the Order's citadel.

citation.text: "Kirtar", section "The Battle for the Mirari". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kirtar organizes a coup, demands command of the Order and uses the Mirari to engulf Pianna in crystals.
timeline.quote: Kirtar used the Mirari on Pianna, creating a wave of crystals that engulfed her.

citation.text: "Kirtar", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The spell spreads out of control; Turg steals the Mirari and Kirtar fades to nothing as the spell drains his essence.
timeline.quote: Kirtar faded away to nothing as the spell drained away his very essence to feed itself.

citation.text: "Kirtar", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kirtar claims the Mirari to destroy it but is corrupted and uses it to kill Pianna.
timeline.quote: Instead, he took it to the Order's citadel and used it to kill Pianna

citation.text: "Mirari", section "Discovery". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kirtar's uncontrolled spell devastates the citadel and kills him.
timeline.quote: Kirtar was unable to end his spell, which went on to devastate the citadel and kill the Lieutenant.

citation.text: "Mirari", section "Discovery". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A Krosan dragon attacks; Kamahl lands the killing blow but is pinned under the carcass and Kirtar takes the glory and the sphere.
timeline.quote: Despite Kamahl being he who dealt the killing blow, he remains pinned down underneath the carcass, and Kirtar takes the glory instead.

citation.text: "Odyssey (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Laquatus reaches Kirtar at the Order encampment; Pianna demands the sphere and Kirtar plots a coup.
timeline.quote: The aven reluctantly complies but plots a coup

citation.text: "Odyssey (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kirtar tries to gain control of the Order with the sphere but its power devastates the city, leaving him and Pianna dead; Turg takes the artifact.
timeline.quote: leaving him and Pianna dead, and the city in ruins.

citation.text: "Odyssey (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Pianna travels to Krosa when Kirtar slaughters the forest's animals and orders him to withdraw.
timeline.quote: Pianna ordered Kirtar to withdraw his remaining men back to the citadel

citation.text: "Pianna", section "Confronting Kirtar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Pianna maps the attacks, finds they match Kirtar's route, and asks him to destroy the Mirari; he refuses and plots a coup.
timeline.quote: He instead organized a coup against Pianna by his fellow aven warriors

citation.text: "Pianna", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kirtar traps Pianna in solid crystal with the Mirari, killing her; the spell destroys the citadel and Kirtar.
timeline.quote: Kirtar used the Mirari to trap Pianna in a solid crystal, instantly killing her

citation.text: "Pianna", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Turg first fights Seton and Kamahl while Laquatus pursues Kirtar across Otaria's northern plains.
timeline.quote: Turg briefly fought them but withdrew at Laquatus's command

citation.text: "Turg", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Order's citadel, Turg fights Kamahl, then takes the Mirari from Kirtar but mistakenly hands it to Satas.
timeline.quote: Turg then mistakenly gave the orb to Satas

citation.text: "Turg", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Implanted false memories of friendship in Kirtar to steal the Mirari.
relations.quote: had implanted false memories of friendship in the Aven's mind

citation.text: "Kirtar", section "The Battle for the Mirari". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
